'''2012 European Championship Cedrik Vanderhaegen LS Restore Freedom To The Galaxy''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-restorefreedomtothegalaxy-pre.gif|label=Restore Freedom To The Galaxy / We'll Need A New One}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
